Appearance in the Umbral Grotto | type = Dredge | profession = mo | service = Collector | level = 24 (24) | campaign = Prophecies | campaign2 = Eye of the North }} [[Molenin]] is a [[Dredge]] slave with a desire to free his enslaved brethren from their erstwhile oppressors. He can be found both in the [[The Iron Arch|Iron Arch]] area of [[Sorrow's Furnace]] and later in the [[Tarnished Coast]] [[outpost]] of [[Umbral Grotto]]. When found in Sorrow's Furnace: He has a plan to free the Dredge slaves, but to implement it he needs the [[Enslavement Stone]]s carried by the [[Stone Summit]]. When found in Umbral Grotto: He needs your assistance to free his people by killing off the [[Summit Taskmaster]]s. ==Locations== * [[Southern Shiverpeaks]] ** {{NPC location|Sorrow's Furnace}} * [[Tarnished Coast]] ** {{NPC location|Umbral Grotto}} ==Quests== '''Quests given:''' * [[Dredging the Depths]] ==Skills== * {{skill icon|Signet of Devotion}} * {{skill icon|Smite Hex}} * {{skill icon|Strength of Honor}} * {{skill icon|Watchful Spirit}} ==Dialogue== Sorrow's Furnace: : ''"Our oppressors have had their day in the sun. It is our turn to breathe the fresh air of freedom. Aid me in my efforts to sabotage the Summit's machinery, and soon all of us will be free. I need 5 [[Enslavement Stone]]s to carry out my plan. I can offer you one of the following [[item]]s in exchange. What do you say? Are you with us, friend?"'' Umbral Grotto: : ''"Proceed carefully, friend. The slavers are in constant need of fresh "recruits.""'' ==Collector items== {{:Molenin/Collector}} ==Trivia== * The name Molenin (and some of his quests, specifically one which references the moletariate, a play on the word proletariat) are a reference to the 20th century Russian Revolutionary [[W:Vladimir Ilyich Lenin|Vladimir Ilyich Lenin]].
